instructions: Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest '- <reason>'`.

`$DISMISS_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids rest-thread-990000 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --adopt-existing-replies --resolve-thread-ids rest-thread-990000 --require-sha HEAD`
